integrity: The three-reaction center reduction and the scalar Adler clock are background. The concentration occupation density and the matched periodic and critical exposure follow by using the physical clock on the positive chemical trajectories.
scientific_limitations: Requires A>0, D>A, C>F>=0 on the specified center locus. Occupation samples one periodic trajectory in physical time; exposure on the critical pulse is an improper integral. The full exterior arc is described only in x>0, not necessarily y>0. No stochastic or off-locus claim.
title: Concentration occupation and exposure at a three-reaction chemical center
